changes.text: In March 2024 the company disposed of Blockchain Dynamics Limited and exited its 2020-2024 cryptocurrency business, then reentered the cryptocurrency business in May 2024 focused on the Bitcoin market.
changes.evidence: In March 2024, we completed the disposal of Blockchain Dynamics Limited and the exit of our 2020-2024 cryptocurrency business.

changes.text: In September 2025 the company disposed of its Legacy Business to focus on its Digital Assets Business.
changes.evidence: On September 15, 2025, we disposed of the Legacy Business to AR iCapital LLP, a Singaporean company, in exchange for nominal cash consideration of US$1, in order to focus on our Digital Assets Business.
